lines.369680624772526081: Hello, uh, my name is Red Walker and I’m calling from Silver Pines.
lines.369680624772526082: I'm on a payphone, the number is 445555. There’s something very weird going on here.
lines.369680624772526083: The town is empty of people but full of… things. I can’t quite explain it. You should come down here and see for yourself.
lines.369680624801886208: Is this Red Walker? I’m calling from CONMAG regarding your recent tip.
lines.369680624801886209: Yes! This is him, I mean that’s me. Thank god you called.
lines.369680624801886210: Did you really say that you were in Silver Pines?
lines.369680624801886211: Yes, that’s where I am, I’m on a payphone in town.
lines.369680624801886212: Forgive me for sounding sceptical, but exactly how did you get there?
lines.369680624810274816: I - uh, I guess I drove here, why?
lines.369680624810274817: Yeah right, you drove there. Gimme a break man, is that supposed to be funny?
lines.369680624810274818: We’re doing SERIOUS journalistic work here, we’re trying to get to the TRUTH, and people like you don’t make things any easier for us.
lines.369680624810274819: Good bye sir, and a good night to you.
lines.369680624814469120: The number you have dialed is not available.
lines.369680624852217856: Mario’s, can I take your order?
lines.369680624860606465: This is Dana at Mario’s pizza. Can I take your order please?
lines.369680624864800769: Century street, Seattle. If you don’t want to order any food that’s fine, have a nice day sir.
lines.369680624864800770: Wait! Maybe you can help me–
lines.369680624864800771: You’re holding up the line, happy to take your order if you’ve changed your mind.
lines.369680624864800772: Okay. Can I have a… Pepperoni Pizza?
lines.369680624868995072: One pepperoni. And what’s the address?
lines.369680624873189377: All signs point to the Crimson Bear Motel as Eddie Velvet's last location.
lines.369680624873189378: Searching the Crimson Bear motel. I’ll find Eddie Velvet for you.
lines.369680624873189379: Eddie was on a cable car. I'll try and retrace his steps.
lines.369680624877383680: Still searching for Eddie. I won’t let you down.
lines.369680624898355200: I'll find Eddie for you, Mr Jackman.
lines.369680624944492544: Still searching. I won't let you down.
lines.369680624948686849: I just arrived. Why do you ask?
lines.369680624948686850: There’s an evacuation order in effect. Most people have left, I’m only here to make sure no one gets stranded.
lines.369680624948686851: They say it’s going to be one hell of a storm.
lines.369680624948686852: I’m looking for a guy called Eddie Velvet, have you seen him?
lines.369680624952881152: Afraid not. Probably skipped town like every other sane person.
lines.369680624952881153: Is he a friend of yours?
lines.369680624952881154: Not exactly. I'm a private investigator. I need to find him for my client.
lines.369680624957075456: Is that so? Well, I won't keep you. Just be careful, uh?
